section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes a single study that explored a model of positive body image, specifically body appreciation, among college women. The study examined interpersonal and intrapersonal factors influencing body appreciation and its ties to well-being indices like depressive symptoms and intuitive eating. Key findings highlight body appreciation's mediational role between maladaptive perfectionism, attachment anxiety, restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, and intuitive eating, but not depressive symptomatology. The section also discusses barriers and facilitators to body appreciation and the predictors of discrepancy perfectionism.
